item.title: School closing prediction for Friday, Feb. 6
item.description: Freezing drizzle overnight could lead to school closings in West Michigan Friday, potentially widespread if it's able to materialize.

item.title: Paw Paw vineyard looks to expand concert space
item.description: A winery in Paw Paw is looking to expand its concert space ahead of this summer, but plans will first need approval from village leaders and some neighbors already have noise concerns.

item.title: Alger Middle School principal placed on leave after he was jailed for violating probation
item.description: The principal of Alger Middle School in Grand Rapids has been placed on administrative leave, the district says, after he was jailed for violating the terms of his probation following a drunken driving conviction.

item.title: 'Chance of justice': Man charged with 2023 murder of 16-year-old
item.description: More than three years after a 16-year-old was found with a fatal gunshot wound in East Grand Rapids, police say a man has been charged with his murder.

item.title: Muskegon Luge sees interest peak ahead of winter Olympics
item.description: Interest in the winter Olympics is sparking excitement at Muskegon Luge Adventure Sports Park ahead of Friday’s opening ceremony.

item.title: Portage family after birth in parking lot: 'Beautiful experience'
item.description: A family in Portage is reflecting on a chaotic experience with laughter and joy.

item.title: Apartment residents 'frustrated' with no elevator, flooding, heating issues
item.description: Residents at Grandview Apartments, a senior living facility, say they’ve been dealing with one problem after another — heating issues, flooding and an elevator out of service for three days.

item.title: Muskegon County appoints interim after commissioner's death
item.description: The Muskegon County Board of Commissioners has named an interim replacement for Commissioner Darrell Paige, who died Saturday after a long battle with cancer.
